data.title: Restaurant Kitchen and Dining Room
data.summary: A realistic full-service commercial kitchen and dining room: cooking line, prep, cold store, dishwash, the pass, tables, banquettes, booths and table settings.
data.description: Back of house at working scale plus a dressed dining room, in one coherent modern realistic family. The cooking line is built as real catering equipment: stainless cases on adjustable bullet feet, control fasciae with dials and indicator lamps, cast pan-support grates over open burner rings in pressed spill trays, wire fryer baskets and hinged lids, salamander radiant plaques, combi ovens with sealed glazed doors on lever handles, and gastronorm apertures with recessed wells. Front of house carries piped seat pads and welted upright back pads on banquettes, booths and chairs, a panelled service bar on the 600 mm counter-run grid, and a full set of table settings. Servery modules expose counter-left and counter-right ports; the walk-in cold room tiles on a 1 m insulated panel grid with a corner and a door bay. Every door, drawer, lid, flap and sliding leaf ships a rigid open and close clip on its own pivot: node transforms only, no skinning. All original CC0 geometry with no brands, logos or menu wording.
